html_content:
Music Lessons in West Island, Montreal

The West Island's leading music school offering private instruction in voice, piano, guitar, drums, and brass. Proudly serving Pointe-Claire, Dollard-des-Ormeaux, Kirkland, Beaconsfield, Pierrefonds, and Dorval.

Book Your Free Trial Lesson

Limited Time: Free trial lesson for new students!

Our Music Programs

Voice Training

Collaborative vocal coaching emphasizing performance and technique for all ages.

Piano & Keyboard Lessons

Private piano lessons for all levels and ages, from beginners to RCM exam preparation.

Guitar & Strings Lessons

Learn guitar, violin, cello, and bass from experienced West Island instructors.

Rock/Garage Bands

Semi-private band programs integrating talent and confidence building.

Brass & Wind Instruments

Trumpet, saxophone, clarinet, and flute lessons in our Pointe-Claire studio.

West Island's Premier Music School

Founded over 50 years ago, we are the West Island's "one stop" destination for all your musical needs. Located at Plaza Pointe-Claire, our studios and store feature steam air purification for your safety and comfort.
